title: Tangential divergence of the rotation field g·(⟨y,u⟩e − ⟨y,e⟩u) on a plane through the radial direction
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, all u, e, v, w ∈ ℝ^P such that (v, w) is orthonormal, every linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^P with Q = span{v, w}, every function g : ℝ^P → ℝ and every t ∈ ℝ such that g is differentiable at t·v, the vector field X(y) := g(y)·(⟨y,u⟩e − ⟨y,e⟩u) satisfies tr(P_Q ∘ DX(tv)) = Dg(tv)w · t·(⟨v,u⟩⟨w,e⟩ − ⟨v,e⟩⟨w,u⟩), where P_Q is the orthogonal projection onto Q and DX(tv), Dg(tv) are the Fréchet derivatives at tv.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (u e v w : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (t : ℝ), Orthonormal ℝ ![v, w] → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![v, w]) = Q → DifferentiableAt ℝ g (t • v) → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (Q.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => g y • (inner ℝ y u • e - inner ℝ y e • u)) (t • v)).toLinearMap) = fderiv ℝ g (t • v) w * (t * (inner ℝ v u * inner ℝ w e - inner ℝ v e * inner ℝ w u))
